steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule before publishing.
Invite the vendors mapped to the PR products without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: on the eRFX create screen, add one required Terms and Conditions clause and stop with the clause visible or saved

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated domain step.
Publish the completed Technical plus RFQ event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 100.
Assert that the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have a different invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 90.
Assert that the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Verify that the buyer sees both direct vendor responses.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluation and awarding.
Score and submit the technical responses as the assigned evaluator.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding and technical evaluation.
Verify that both bidding vendors appear with real company names.
Assert that the lower RFQ amount ranks first.
Award the complete event to the lowest bidder.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
